_atlassian_comment: Atlassian instances by name; one entry serves both the `jira` and `confluence` sources.
A source picks one with its `instance` param — omit it when only one is configured.
The method fixes the HOST, because each credential is honored by exactly one:
oauth        — Cloud, via api.atlassian.com. Register a Lorekeeper-only app at
Atlassian ROTATES refresh tokens, so a grant shared with another tool
invalidates both on every run — never point this at another client's token.
scoped-token — Cloud, via api.atlassian.com. A SCOPED account token; the site ignores
one rather than refusing it, so it must be addressed here. Needs cloud_id,
api-token    — Cloud, at the site. A CLASSIC (unscoped) account token; the gateway
refuses one, so it must be addressed at the site.
pat          — Data Center / Server personal access token. Put the context path in site_url.
An IP allowlist is a separate matter and judges WHO asks, not where: it turns away an
account token at either host and admits an org-approved app, so from an address the list
does not name, oauth is the only method that reaches the API.
